This will involve no new construction and is within the designed capacity of the Fort. A U.S. helicopter unit will vacate one area of Albrook Airfield and a Panamanian helicopter unit will move in. There should be no appreciable difference in the noise resulting from these operations. The Panamanian Navy may move a few vessels to some of the piers at Rodman and some to Coco Solo on the Atlantic side. In addition to these moves, over the next 2-3 years elements of a Panamanian National Guard battalion will move into facilities at Curundu flats; no new construction will be required by this Consequently, Panamanian military relocation will result in no significant environmental impacts.
